prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” HVAC company for everyone — the right choice depends on your exact location in Houston, the make/age of your system, how quickly you need service, and whether you value lowest price, long warranties, or same‑day emergency response. I can, however, point you to several reputable companies and give a short checklist so you can pick the best one for your situation.

Reputable Houston AC companies to consider
- John Moore Services — long-established Houston company, wide service area, handles both repairs and replacements.
- ARS/Rescue Rooter (Houston) — large national firm with extensive resources and emergency availability.
- Baker Brothers Plumbing, AC & Electrical — strong local reputation for customer service and follow-up.
- One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning (local franchise) — known for on-time guarantees and quick service.
- ABC Home & Commercial Services — national/local hybrid, good for full‑service and maintenance plans.

How to choose (quick checklist)
- Licensing & insurance: verify the tech and company are licensed in Texas and carry liability insurance.
- Reviews & complaints: check Google, Yelp, Angi/Thumbtack, and the BBB for recent reviews and complaint history.
- Up‑front pricing: ask for a written estimate and whether they charge a diagnostic/trouble‑call fee.
- Warranties: confirm parts and labor warranties and any manufacturer transferability.
- Experience with your system: ask if they’ve worked on your brand and model before.
- Emergency/after‑hours policy: what’s the response time and extra fees for nights/weekends?
- COVID/entry policies and tech ID: confirm proof of ID, vehicle markings, and payment methods.

Typical costs and expectations (ballpark)
- Diagnostic fee: commonly $75–$200 (may be credited toward repair).
- Minor repairs (capacitor, contactor, thermostat): often $150–$600.
- Major repairs (compressor, coil): can range $1,000–$3,500 depending on unit and labor.
- Full system replacement: often $3,500–$10,000+ depending on tonnage, efficiency, and installation complexity.

If you want a specific recommendation, tell me your ZIP code (or neighborhood), whether you need emergency service, and whether you prefer local businesses or national chains. I can then find highly rated providers nearby, compare reviews, and give phone numbers or next steps.
